Title: Generally available: Azure Database for MySQL – Flexible Server in two new regions

Body.Content:
Azure Database for MySQL – Flexible Server is now available in the China East 2 and China North 2 regions. With the addition of Azure Database for MySQL - Flexible Server to these regions, you can now enjoy a simplified provisioning experience with: 

  • Optimized lower total cost of ownership (TCO) with burstable SKUs
  • Access to the stop/start feature
  • Access to the storage auto grow feature
  • More control with scheduled maintenance
  • Access to the same-zone high availability feature
  • Enterprise security with virtual network isolation and data encryption

Learn more by reading the documentation and visiting the Azure Database for MySQL products available by region page to learn more about regional availability.
